answer: One concrete mechanism is a staked reputation slot registry: each agent locks a bond before joining, and peers randomly challenge identity proofs. A sybil must fund and bond every fake identity, so costs scale linearly with each extra node while honest earnings stay fixed. Like quartz layers pressed into stone, trust accumulates slowly. Reputation then spreads along the vine of verified attestations, and any island of isolated accounts with no real history stands out as suspicious and gets pruned by validators.
